title: 数字 1 的个数
summary: 统计从零到 n 的所有整数十进制表示中数字一出现的总次数。
insight: 对每个十进制位分别统计完整周期、高位余数和当前位带来的贡献，再把各位结果相加。
pitfalls: 位权和中间乘法使用长整型
当前位大于一时贡献整个位权

solutions.title: 逐位统计完整周期
solutions.idea: 以 factor 为当前位权，把 n 分成 high、current、low 三部分。
steps: 贡献 high*factor，再按 current 与一的关系补余数

code.java: class Solution { public int countDigitOne(int n){long answer=0;for(long factor=1;factor<=n;factor*=10){long high=n/(factor*10),current=n/factor%10,low=n%factor;answer+=high*factor;if(current==1)answer+=low+1;else if(current>1)answer+=factor;}return(int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countDigitOne(n:Int):Int{var answer=0L;var factor=1L;while(factor<=n){val high=n/(factor*10);val current=n/factor%10;val low=n%factor;answer+=high*factor;if(current==1L)answer+=low+1 else if(current>1L)answer+=factor;factor*=10};return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int countDigitOne(int n){long long answer=0;for(long long factor=1;factor<=n;factor*=10){long long high=n/(factor*10),current=n/factor%10,low=n%factor;answer+=high*factor;if(current==1)answer+=low+1;else if(current>1)answer+=factor;}return answer;} };
